name: Shambala
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:movement)(Tag:space)Dubbed "Dimensional Formation", Shambala is a pendant Teigu that teleports you and others over short and long distances via set sigils, but heavily strains stamina and usually needs time between uses. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to use and can only be used by people who are compatible with it. (A/N: Anime Exclusive Trump Card is not included).
